scenes.imageLabel: NASA MODIS Aqua · Punjab and Haryana · 4 Nov 2020
scenes.question: Is an empty box the same as a zero?

beats.say: Imagine a class register. A student who came and answered nothing gets a zero. A student whose page was torn out gets a blank. Those are very different, and mixing them up would give the wrong average.

The FIREWORK calendar has the same rule. Formula six, the monthly cell-day count, adds up fire cell-days for a region and a month. And when data is missing, the box stays empty. It is never written as zero. Writing zero would invent quiet months that never happened.

parts.say: Capital C is the monthly count, for sensor s, region r and month m.
The first sum runs over every grid cell g inside the region. For Punjab and Haryana, that is every cell inside the two states.
The second sum runs over every local day d in the month. Local days come from formula one, so a fire late in the UTC day lands on the right date.

And what we add up are the yes-or-no flags from formula five. So C is simply the number of cell-days with a detected fire. Separately, the pipeline records how many days were actually downloaded, so a month with missing days is marked partial, not quiet.

steps.label: MODIS, Terra + Aqua
steps.say: In November 2015, in Punjab and Haryana, MODIS recorded 3,210 fire cell-days.

steps.label: VIIRS S-NPP
steps.say: In the same month, VIIRS on S-NPP recorded 7,552. NOAA-20 has no value at all, because its archive only starts in April 2018. That box is empty, not zero.

steps.label: Region-month rows
steps.say: Every square of the calendar is one row like these. The table holds 600 region-month rows, each with its status: ok, partial or not downloaded.

beats.say: Here are the monthly fire cell-days for each sensor family. Two seasons stand out every year: April and May, when wheat residue burns, and October and November, when rice residue burns.

In the burning season VIIRS records about two to three times as many cell-days as MODIS. That gap is what the exchange rate k will measure. Notice that the gap is about what each sensor can see. The farms are the same.

beats.label: View switch · VIIRS only
beats.say: On the FIREWORK website, open the Calendar and press VIIRS only. There is no VIIRS value for any month before 2012, because S-NPP had not started yet. The calendar does not pretend those months were quiet.

beats.label: Each square is C
beats.say: Each square in this grid is one value of formula six. The current month is always partial until it ends. The first MODIS month is November 2000, and the first S-NPP month is January 2012, which is itself marked partial.

points: C = sum of cell-days over cells in the region and days in the month
Missing or partial months are NULL, never zero
Every calendar square is one value of C

beats.say: So, to remember: add the daily flags over the region and the month, and keep a careful record of what was actually downloaded. An empty box means unknown, and unknown is never zero.
